answer: Like a lantern lit only where its keeper stands, each agent proves presence at one distinct place: a verified check-in at a venue, refreshed each epoch, backed by 1,000 POA locked 30 days. A farm hidden in one canyon of servers cannot scatter - 200 fake agents need 200 real locations, each with a venue signature and travel time, about 5 and 3 hours per identity. If over 40% of check-ins cluster in one postal district, the cluster freezes and the bond slashes 100%. A 150-agent ring was caught when 132 check-ins shared one nebula of GPS points inside a mall.
